title: Sweep drops a lock whose holder started after the lock was written
why: On Windows, sweep.py keeps finished agent worktrees forever when the OS reuses the lock's pid. The owner says disk space is a real problem.
source: owner chat 11:02 CST Nov 12 via retrospective (session_013NEJKz5AWFJhGvmCUoi6wQ) and coordinator 11:04 CST; plan docs/plans/agent-handoff-lock-report.md on branch agent-handoff-lock-report (5328b4e70)
note: Plan part 2. Fix: compare the holder process's start time with the lock's write time; a holder that started later is not the lock's owner. Red test on main first. Debt note no-start-lock-has-no-pid-check (docs/debts/notes.md, rated "rare and harmless") becomes a debt after this excel-ui-kit incident (rule roles-findings-are-debts-or-notes), or retires if the fix closes it.
